text: This staff report is about a matter for which the North York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This is a report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing and Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard cafe permit located at 518 Eglinton Avenue West, Heddington Avenue flankage.
North York Community Council withdrew Item NY13.27 as the applicant withdrew their application.
